clusters.title: 43% of servers never start under the fleet harness
clusters.detail:
Most are servers that need credentials or a runtime Sealmark's launch inference does not provide. Sealmark should report the reason as a typed result (needs-credentials, missing-runtime, bad-launch) instead of one opaque start error. Top signatures:
- 155x `could not start or talk to the server: MCP error -#: Connection closed (server s`
- 20x `the server did not answer initialize within # s (--connect-timeout). The first s`
- 1x `could not start or talk to the server: MCP error -#: Not signed in. Run `cso-cli`
- 1x `could not start or talk to the server: MCP error -#: Not signed in. Run `cto-cli`
